pages.title: Enchanter's Bangle
pages.description: This magic accessory has a chance to boost the damage of your spells. Its magic is unstable but perhaps attuning it to a school can stabilize its abilities.
This bangle will  boost the damage of  your Fire spells.  Your arms are  engulfed in the  element, setting on  fire enemies hit and  granting a passive  boost to speed while  in hot biomes.

This bangle will  boost the damage of  your Water spells.  Your arms chills the  air around, freezing  enemies on every  hit. It will also  grant the wearer a  passive boost to  speed in water and  rain.
This bangle will  boost the damage of  your Air spells.  Your arms sparks  with the element,  giving a passive  boost to speed and  attack knockback.

This bangle will  boost the damage of  your Earth spells.  Plants blossom on  your arms,  inflicting snare to  enemies hit and  granting the wearer  immunity to cactus  and berry bushes and  knockback  resistance.
This bangle will  boost the damage of  your Summoning  spells. Your summons  follows your arms  movement, targeting  whatever your hit  with increased  damage.

This bangle will  boost the damage of  your Anima spells.  You can feel a cycle  of life and death in  your arms, randomly  healing or withering  the enemies hit and  giving you a small  health boost.
